# .github

## Purpose

Repository-hosted coding assistant instructions for contributors.

## Files

- `copilot-instructions.md` - Contributor rules for repository changes.

## Execution and connections

Read by supported coding assistants; not loaded by the JARVIS runtime.

Instructions describe privacy, testing, and code-change expectations.

See the [architecture guide](../docs/architecture.md) for the end-to-end flow and [folder map](../docs/folder-map.md) for repository-wide navigation.
